name: Codex CLI
description: OpenAI's open-source terminal coding agent: runs shell commands and edits files in a working directory to complete a task.
command: export HOME=/tmp CODEX_HOME=/tmp/.codex && mkdir -p /tmp/.codex && printenv OPENAI_API_KEY | codex login --with-api-key >/dev/null 2>&1 && cd /work && exec codex exec --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox -m gpt-4o-mini "$SMADP_AGENT_TASK"
notes: Locally-built image (FROM node:22-slim + `npm install -g @openai/codex`), approved by local image id like autogen/gpt-engineer. Runs headless via `codex exec --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox` (SMADP's container already provides isolation). Auth is set up per-run with `codex login --with-api-key` piped from OPENAI_API_KEY.
